name: Naqada culture (Predynastic Egypt)
summary: The Copper Age culture of Upper Egypt that came just before the pharaohs. Its leaders, crafts and early hieroglyphs led directly to the unification of Egypt around 3100 BCE.

location.value: Upper Egypt along the Nile, named after the town of Naqada.

terrain.value: The narrow Nile valley between deserts.
terrain.source: Wengrow, The Archaeology of Early Egypt (2006)

climate.value: Increasingly dry; people moved closer to the Nile.
climate.source: Wengrow, The Archaeology of Early Egypt (2006)
